name: ai-chatbot-platform
description: Production-Ready Embeddable AI Chatbot Platform with Gemini & Supabase

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install && cd ../widget && npm install
scripts.vercel-build: npm run install:all && npm run build:widget && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:widget && npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
